name: Hotel Sanman Deluxe
signature_dish: Jolada rotti thali with brinjal ennegai
why_it_matters: A long-running Station Road hotel-restaurant in central Badami, the base town for the Chalukya UNESCO triangle. Its ground-floor dining hall and attached bar-restaurant are a standard reliable stop for travellers staying overnight before the Aihole-Pattadakal-Badami cave circuit, with the North Karnataka jolada-rotti-and-ennegai meal available alongside the usual multi-cuisine menu.
insider_tip: Ask for the local jolada-rotti thali rather than the default North Indian menu — the sorghum-flatbread-with-brinjal-curry meal is what North Karnataka eats and most visitors miss it. Station Road is a short walk from the bus stand, handy for an early start to the caves.
signature_address: Station Road, central Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Hotel Mookambika Deluxe
area: Station Road, near Badami bus stand
signature_dish: South Indian breakfast and North Karnataka veg thali
why_it_matters: A budget hotel-restaurant near the Badami bus stand on Station Road, one of the most frequently cited cheap-stay-plus-food addresses for travellers doing the Chalukya cave circuit. The kitchen runs an early South Indian breakfast service and a midday veg thali — practical anchors for a town where dining options cluster on one road.
insider_tip: Its location next to the bus stand makes it the easy first-meal stop on arrival. South Indian breakfast is served early; for the local flavour ask whether jolada rotti is on that day's thali.
signature_address: Station Road, near Badami bus stand, Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya
area: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals in the government tourism hotel garden
why_it_matters: The Karnataka State Tourism Development Corporation hotel in Badami, with a garden, restaurant and beer parlour close to the Badami cave temples. As the official KSTDC 'Mayura' property for the Chalukya triangle, it is a dependable sit-down option and is the Mayura restaurant for this circuit — the one routinely (and wrongly) cited as being 'at Aihole' is in fact this Badami property.
insider_tip: It is the calmest sit-down meal in town, set in a garden rather than on the busy Station Road strip. Useful for a late lunch after the caves. Being a government property, it keeps standard hours — call ahead for dinner timing in the off season.
signature_address: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples, Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Geeta Darshini
signature_dish: Masala dosa and South Indian tiffin
why_it_matters: A no-frills pure-veg darshini on Badami's main road, the kind of stand-up South Indian tiffin counter that locals use for an early dosa or idli before work. It is the budget-breakfast anchor of the town and a standing fixture in Badami food listings.
insider_tip: This is a breakfast and snacks stop, not a dinner restaurant — go in the morning for the freshest dosa batch. Stand-up or quick-seat service, cash-friendly. Pair with a filter coffee before heading to the caves.
signature_address: Main Road, Badami town, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Badami Court Restaurant
area: Station Road extension, near Badami camp layout
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine sit-down meals at the Badami Court hotel
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of Badami Court, one of the better-equipped hotels in town set on the Station Road extension. It is the comfortable air-conditioned sit-down option for travellers who want a quieter, fuller-service meal than the bustle of the central Station Road eateries, and rates well on Tripadvisor.
insider_tip: Non-residents are welcome but it is the more expensive end of Badami dining — best for an unhurried dinner. Set slightly out of the town centre, so it pairs naturally with a stay there. Reserve in peak season.
signature_address: Station Road extension, near Badami camp layout, Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Hotel Paradise Family Restaurant
area: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre
signature_dish: Tandoori chicken tikka with North Indian gravies
why_it_matters: Currently the highest-ranked restaurant in Badami on Tripadvisor (#1 of the town's listed restaurants) and rated 4.4/5 across 240-plus reviews on Justdial. A family restaurant near the LIC Office on Station Road serving Indian, Chinese and tandoori in both veg and non-veg, with free parking out front — a practical, well-liked dinner choice.
insider_tip: The tandoori section is the draw — chicken tikka and gobi tikka get the most repeat praise. It is on Station Road near the LIC Office, central and easy to find. Good for groups; they handle larger tables.
signature_address: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201
